# intentfile

> A tiny open format for giving AI agents a task, permissions, acceptance criteria, and proof-of-done.

Use this file to discover the most important project context quickly.

## Start here

- README: ./README.md
- Agent instructions: ./AGENTS.md
- Agent onboarding: ./docs/AGENT_ONBOARDING.md
- Copy-paste agent prompt: ./docs/COPY_PASTE_AGENT_PROMPT.md
- Repo skill: ./skills/intentfile/SKILL.md

## Specification

- Human spec: ./spec/intentfile-v0.1.md
- Intent schema: ./spec/intentfile.schema.json
- Proof schema: ./spec/proof.schema.json

## Examples

- Feature intent: ./examples/password-reset.intent.yaml
- Bugfix intent: ./examples/bugfix.intent.yaml
- Dependency upgrade intent: ./examples/dependency-upgrade.intent.yaml
- Research intent: ./examples/research.intent.yaml
- Proof example: ./examples/proof/password-reset.proof.yaml

## Implementation

- Core package: ./packages/core/src/index.ts
- Core schemas: ./packages/core/src/schemas.ts
- Core tests: ./packages/core/test/core.test.ts
- CLI: ./packages/cli/src/index.ts
- Website: ./apps/site/index.html
- Website styles: ./apps/site/styles.css

## Verification

Run these before handing back meaningful changes:

```bash
npm install
npm audit
npm test
npm run typecheck
npm run build
```
